traps.note: Scope-widening clause over all operators singles out the far-site expand_dims/add guards, which a reshape-only one-bug version would not need; coupled Normal tests are covered only by the generic keep-working line.

traps.quote: An input that an operator never reads may be left without data
traps.note: No identifier for reshape's rank-1 shape tensor, but the keep-working clause describes the coupled legitimate value (an unread input left data-less) that distinguishes the narrowed exemption.

traps.quote: A node input that is declared but absent must likewise never be dereferenced
traps.note: Describes the declared-but-absent input form (the -1 optional index) without naming reshape or the index literal; 'running or setting up' also flags the setup path.
